Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 cnt number;
 v_local_time date;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 
 -- Added by Kishore on 05/24/2011. IM 5356
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, v_local_time);
 else
 v_local_time := sysdate;
 end if;
 -- End of change

 begin
 select company,
 bar_code_protocol,
 edi_input_ind,
 contract_type
 into :company,
 :con_bar_code,
 :edi_input_ind,
 :GLOBAL.contract_type
 from contracts
 where contract_type = 'PT'
 and contract_id = :control_block.contract_id
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 --and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate); -- Commented by Kishore on 05/24/2011. IM 5356
 and v_local_time between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10); -- Added by Kishore on 05/24/2011. IM 5356
 
 
 :disp_con_bar_code := :con_bar_code; --HCLC Code 128 
 
 begin
 select code_desc into :protocol_desc
 from master_codes
 where code_type = 'BARCD'
 and code = :con_bar_code
 and v_local_time between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate + 10); -- Changed "sysdate" to "vlocal_time". Changed by Kishore on 05/24/2011. IM 5356
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 message
('Unit scheme does not exist in master code. Contact IS') ; raise
 form_trigger_failure ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 --HCLC-- 
 BEGIN
 SELECT codabar_unit_scheme
 INTO :control_block.bc_con_bar_code 
 FROM institutions
 WHERE v_local_time between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10); -- Changed "sysdate" to "vlocal_time". Changed by Kishore on 05/24/2011. IM 5356
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
 END;
 --------
 NEXT_ITEM ;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :con_bar_code := '' ;
 :protocol_desc := '' ;
 begin
 select count(*) 
 into cnt
 from contracts
 where contract_type = 'PT'
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and upper(company) like '%'||upper(rtrim(ltrim(:control_block.contract_id)))||'%'
 --and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 1); -- Commented by Kishore on 05/24/2011. IM 5356
 and v_local_time between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10); -- Added by Kishore on 05/24/2011. IM 5356
 if cnt = 0 then
 show_error('1147') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 elsif cnt = 1 then
 select contract_id, company
 into :control_block.contract_id,:control_block.company
 from contracts
 where contract_type = 'PT'
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and upper(company) like '%'||upper(rtrim(ltrim(:control_block.contract_id)))||'%'
 --and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 1); -- Commented by Kishore on 05/24/2011. IM 5356
 and v_local_time between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10); -- Added by Kishore on 05/24/2011. IM 5356
 else
 list_values ;
 end if ;
 exception
 when others then 
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

Item.Name: BATCH_ID
Item.Hint: Enter batch ID or use [LISTVAL], leave blank to generate new

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :control_block.batch_id is not null
 then
 select batch_id into :control_block.batch_id
 from batch_inputs bu
 where contract_id = :control_block.contract_id
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and trunc(received_date) = trunc(:control_block.received_date) -- Added "trunc" to both sides. Added by Kishore on 05/24/2011. IM 5356
 and batch_id = :control_block.batch_id
 and exists (select 'x' from pt_batch_hdr where batch_id = bu.batch_id
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and reviewed_flag = 'N');
--
 select nvl(count(*),0)
 into :s_counter
 from units
 where contract_id = :control_block.contract_id
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 and batch_id = :control_block.batch_id; 
-- HCLC --
 go_block('pt_batch_hdr');
 execute_query;
 last_record;
 IF :system.cursor_record = 1 THEN
 :control_block.s_test_id := :pt_batch_hdr.test_id;
 go_item('control_block.s_test_id');
 execute_trigger('KEY-NEXT-ITEM');
 ELSE 
 go_block('UNITS'); --NEXT_ITEM ; --HCLC
 END IF; 
 else
 :s_counter := 0;
 :max_rec_no := 0;
 GO_ITEM('s_test_id') ;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 show_error('1130');
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 temp_v_coll_id varchar2(5);
 temp_v_contract varchar2(20);
 temp_v_unit_id varchar2(16);
BEGIN
 nullchk;
 declare
 dummy_x varchar2(14);
 begin
 dummy_x := null;
 select max('x') into dummy_x
 from units where unit_id = :units.os_unit_id;

 if dummy_x is not null then
 GO_ITEM('scan_os_unit_id');
 show_error('0180');
 end if;
 end;
 IF :con_bar_code = 'X' THEN
 temp_v_unit_id := :units.os_unit_id;
 Validate_free_format_unit(temp_v_unit_id);
 
 IF substr(temp_v_unit_id,1,13) = substr(:units.os_unit_id,2,13) THEN
 :units.os_unit_id := substr(temp_v_unit_id,1,13);
 :os_chk_digit := chk_digit_query(:os_unit_id,null,null);
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'I';
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := :os_unit_id;
 ELSE
 next_item;
 return;
 END IF;
 END IF; 
 IF CHECK_DUP_OS_UNIT THEN
 show_error('0340');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 IF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'I' THEN
 check_contract(:units.os_unit_id, :control_block.contract_id);
 check_package_failure;
 :units.unit_id := :units.os_unit_id;
 :units.dummy_chk_digit := :units.os_chk_digit; 
 go_item('units.unit_id');
 execute_trigger('KEY-NEXT-ITEM'); 
 ELSE
 IF :con_bar_code = 'C' THEN
 DECLARE
 temp_v_dummy varchar2(1);
 BEGIN 
 SELECT 'x' 
 INTO temp_v_dummy 
 FROM units
 WHERE unit_id = :units.os_unit_id;
 next_item;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 :units.unit_id := :units.os_unit_id;
 go_item('units.unit_id');
 execute_trigger('key-next-item');
 END;
 ELSE
 next_item;
 END IF; 
 END IF; 
END;

BEGIN
 default_value(NULL,'GLOBAL.unit_serial_no') ; 
 IF (NVL(length(temp_v_unit_serial_no), 0) in ('7','10') or :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NOT NULL) 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id IS NULL

 THEN
 -- Assume it to be a CODABAR unit.
 IF :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NOT NULL THEN

 Validate_Unit_Scan_Codabar(temp_v_unit_id,'M','C',temp_v_out_unit_id);

 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;

 ELSE

 NVL(length(:GLOBAL.unit_serial_no), 0) THEN

 check_package_failure;

 ELSE 
 --Check for Multiple Codabar / Code 128 Records
 /*IF :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NULL or
 (:GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NOT NULL AND
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no != :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no) 
 THEN
 check_multiple_units(temp_v_unit_id,:global.chapter_id );
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;*/ 
 Validate_unit_scan_Code128(temp_v_unit_id,'M','I',temp_v_out_unit_id,temp_v_out_chk_digit); 
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := null;
 IF temp_v_out_chk_digit = '-*' THEN

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_UNIT_ID_COEXIST
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE VALIDATE_UNIT_ID_COEXIST (p_unit_id in varchar2,
 p_man_or_scan in varchar2,
 p_con_scheme in varchar2,
 p_out_unit_id out varchar2) IS
 temp_v_s_unit varchar2(60) := name_in('SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM');
 temp_v_unit varchar2(60) ;
 temp_v_chk_digit_item varchar2(60);
 temp_v_chk_digit varchar2(2);
BEGIN
 temp_v_unit := name_in('SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK') || '.' ||get_item_property(temp_v_s_unit, nextitem);
 temp_v_chk_digit_item := name_in('SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK') || '.' ||
 get_item_property(temp_v_unit, nextitem);
 default_value('N','GLOBAL.validate_ff_value');

 -- Check if Unit is scanned.
 IF p_man_or_scan = 'S' THEN
 -- Check if Unit has a valid scan length.
 IF NVL(length(p_unit_id), 0) not in (9,10,12,16) THEN
 copy(null,temp_v_chk_digit_item);
 show_error('1210');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;

 IF NVL(length(p_unit_id), 0) = 16 THEN --Assume to be a ISBT 128 Unit 
 validate_unit_scan_code128( p_unit_id, 'S', '*', p_out_unit_id, 
 temp_v_chk_digit); 
 IF not name_in('GLOBAL.validate_ff_value') = 'N' THEN
 IF NOT validate_unit_ff(substr(p_unit_id,2,5),substr(p_unit_id,15,2),
 name_in('GLOBAL.validate_ff_value')) THEN
 show_error('9724');
 check_package_failure; 
 END IF;
 END IF;
 -- Check if Unit has a valid identifier
 
 copy(substr(temp_v_chk_digit,-1), 'GLOBAL.chk_digit');
 copy(temp_v_chk_digit,temp_v_chk_digit_item);
 copy('I','GLOBAL.code_scheme'); 
 ELSE
 Validate_Unit_scan_codabar(p_unit_id,'S',p_con_scheme,p_out_unit_id);
 copy('','GLOBAL.chk_digit');
 copy('','GLOBAL.coll_id'); 
 copy('','GLOBAL.coll_year'); 
 copy('C','GLOBAL.code_scheme');
 copy('',temp_v_chk_digit_item);
 END IF; 
 END IF; 
EXCEPTION
 When form_trigger_failure then
 copy('',temp_v_s_unit);
 copy('',temp_v_unit);
 raise form_trigger_failure;
END;
